# IBRA

Hebrew spelling and pronunciation: איברה (ee-BRA).

> IBRA is an iOS app (Hebrew-first) that runs the workout and nutrition plan your own AI chat (ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini) wrote: a daily player for sets, rest and meals, body measurements and photos, and a weekly close that sends what really happened back to the chat for adjustments. No account, no server; data stays on the phone and in the user's iCloud. One free sample day without signing up; first week free; then a one-time or subscription purchase.

- Home (Hebrew): https://ibra.fit/
- Home (English): https://ibra.fit/en/
- Guide (Hebrew): how to run a ChatGPT workout plan, what to ask, what to send back weekly: https://ibra.fit/chatgpt-workout-plan
- FAQ: https://ibra.fit/faq
- Compared with Hevy, Strong and ChatGPT alone: https://ibra.fit/vs
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/il/app/ibra/id6794155896
- Privacy: https://ibra.fit/privacy · Terms: https://ibra.fit/terms · Support: https://ibra.fit/support
